items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status Pill
items.description: A pill-shaped status indicator with sentiment variants (neutral, info, success, warning, destructive) and an optional status dot. Adds success/warning theme tokens.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A KPI/metric card: title, large tabular value, up/down trend badge, and description. Composable parts. Adds success theme tokens.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical timeline with status dots (default, active, success, warning, destructive), connector lines, titles, times, and descriptions. Adds success/warning theme tokens.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A categorization label colored from the chart token palette (chart-1..5), with optional remove button. Categorization only — never for actions.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A process progress indicator: steps with indicator, label, sublabel, and connector, in horizontal or vertical orientation. Per-step stages: pending, active (aria-current), completed (check), error (destructive). Adopted from Salt DS through the contract.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: An accessible rating input built as a radio group with hover preview, read-only and disabled states, and a consumer-swappable icon (star by default). Adopted from Salt DS through the contract.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: An APG TreeView: expandable nested items with roving tabindex, full arrow-key navigation, typeahead, selection, and per-item icons. Adopted from Salt DS through the contract.

items.name: theme-shadcn
items.title: Theme: shadcn neutral
items.description: The registry's default character compiled from the semantic contract. Import tokens/base.css then this file. Capabilities: light+dark, radius knob. Source: themes/theme-shadcn.json.

items.name: theme-salt
items.title: Theme: Salt DS
items.description: JPMorgan Salt character compiled from the semantic contract: sharp, Salt blue, Open Sans, uppercase actions, density axis (data-density: high|medium|low|touch). Import tokens/base.css then this file. Source: themes/theme-salt.json.
